name: Curiosity Expedition
dateMethod: Approximate UTC calendar equivalent: landing epoch plus mean sol (88775.244 seconds). Inter-leg sols are editorial progress, not exact historical positions.
routeMethod: Edited one-way landmark tour: direct terrain-checked connections, rounded corners and separate return lanes. Intermediate historical driving reversals are omitted. Historical trace is research only.

recovery.policy: Capture last safe grounded pose on active leg before crossing its corridor. Re-entry cancels warning. Lift back to captured pose, preserving progress; use preceding approved recovery point if pose unsafe.
